capabilities.name: admin.createBranch
capabilities.description: Create a branch after owner-only strong approval

capabilities.name: analytics.summary
capabilities.description: Read branch-wide client analytics: total and voucher-client counts plus a breakdown by service status. Use for: 서비스 상태별 통계, 바우처 고객 수, 운영 현황 분석. Input: none. Returns: totalClients, voucherClients, byServiceStatus (status and count per service stage). For a simple total/active headline count, use dashboard.summary instead.

capabilities.name: automation.create
capabilities.description: Create a message automation rule after strong approval

capabilities.name: automation.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a message automation rule and cancel pending jobs after strong approval

capabilities.name: automation.list
capabilities.description: List message automation rules for the current branch

capabilities.name: automation.setActive
capabilities.description: Enable or disable a message automation rule after strong approval

capabilities.name: automation.update
capabilities.description: Update a message automation rule after strong approval

capabilities.name: bank.accounts
capabilities.description: Read the branch's registered bank account references, with account numbers masked to the last 4 digits — never the full account number. Use for: 계좌 정보, 입금 계좌, 은행 확인. Input: optional area keyword, matched partially. Returns: area, bankName, accountLast4.

capabilities.name: calls.list
capabilities.description: List calls for the current branch

capabilities.name: calls.transcriptSummary
capabilities.description: List call transcript summaries without exposing raw transcripts

capabilities.name: clients.create
capabilities.description: Create a client: ask only for missing facts, complete read-only lookups first, then invoke the write tool immediately once required facts are resolved. Never ask the user for conversational confirmation; the structured proposal card is the sole mandatory approval.

capabilities.name: clients.get
capabilities.description: Get one client's summary from the current branch by their numeric client id, not by name — use this after clients.search has resolved the id. Use for: 산모 상세정보, 고객 정보 조회, 특정 산모 확인. Input: id (the client's positive integer id). Returns: id, name, serviceStatus, startDate, endDate, voucherClient.

capabilities.name: clients.search
capabilities.description: Search for one client (산모) in the current branch by name, phone number, or address, and return a single match or a short list to pick from. Use for: 산모 찾기, 고객 조회, 산모님 성함으로 검색. Input: query text is matched partially, case-insensitively, against the client's name, address, and phone number. Returns: id, name, serviceStatus, startDate, endDate, voucherClient. Requires a specific name, phone number or address; never pass a generic word such as 산모, 고객, 관리사 or 직원 as the query — ask the user instead.

capabilities.name: clients.update
capabilities.description: Update an existing client after explicit approval

capabilities.name: consultations.list
capabilities.description: List consultation inquiries (pre-registration leads) for the current branch, newest first. Use for: 상담 문의 목록, 전체 문의 확인, 최근 문의. Input: optional query — when given, matched partially, case-insensitively, against the mother's name, status, or preferred caregiver name; omit it to list everything. Optional limit (max 50, default 20). Returns: id, motherName, dueDate, voucherType, preferredCaregiverName, referralSource, source, status, readAt, createdAt, updatedAt.

capabilities.name: consultations.markRead
capabilities.description: Mark a consultation inquiry read after approval

capabilities.name: consultations.search
capabilities.description: Search consultation inquiries (pre-registration leads) for the current branch by a specific keyword — behaves like consultations.list but is meant for when you already have a name, status, or caregiver to filter by. Use for: 특정 산모 상담 찾기, 상담 상태로 검색, 담당 관리사로 검색. Input: query, matched partially, case-insensitively, against the mother's name, status, or preferred caregiver name. Returns the same fields as consultations.list. Requires a specific value; a generic word such as 산모 or 고객 will match too broadly — use consultations.list without a query to browse everything instead.

capabilities.name: consultations.unread
capabilities.description: List only unread consultation inquiries for the current branch, newest first. Use for: 안읽은 상담, 미확인 문의, 새 문의 확인. Input: optional query (same match fields as consultations.list: mother's name, status, or preferred caregiver name) and optional limit (max 50, default 20). Returns the same fields as consultations.list; every row has readAt = null.

capabilities.name: contracts.dispatch
capabilities.description: Create and send a contract after strong approval

capabilities.name: contracts.status
capabilities.description: Read the eformsign contract/e-signature document status for one specific client. Use for: 계약서 상태, 전자서명 진행상황, 서명 완료 여부 확인. Input: clientId — the client's numeric id; look it up via clients.search first, this does not accept a client name. Returns, per non-deleted document: documentId, documentName, status, statusDetail, updatedDate, expired.

capabilities.name: dashboard.summary
capabilities.description: Give a quick headline count of clients in the current branch, without exposing any personal contact data. Use for: 전체 산모 수, 진행중인 고객 수, 대시보드 요약. Input: none. Returns: totalClients, activeClients. For a breakdown by service status, use analytics.summary instead.

capabilities.name: drafts.confirm
capabilities.description: Confirm a pending client draft through the canonical draft workflow

capabilities.name: drafts.list
capabilities.description: List client drafts for the current branch

capabilities.name: drafts.update
capabilities.description: Update a pending client draft through the canonical draft use case

capabilities.name: employees.changeAvailability
capabilities.description: Change employee availability after explicit approval

capabilities.name: employees.create
capabilities.description: Create an employee after explicit approval

capabilities.name: employees.get
capabilities.description: Get one employee's summary from the current branch by their numeric employee id, not by name — use this after employees.search has resolved the id. Use for: 관리사 상세정보, 직원 정보 조회. Input: id (the employee's positive integer id). Returns: id, name, grade, workArea, openToNextWork. Unlike employees.search, this does not include a computed working/available status.

capabilities.name: employees.search
capabilities.description: Search for one employee (caregiver/staff) in the current branch by name or work area, and return a single match or a short list to pick from. Use for: 관리사 찾기, 제공인력 조회, 도우미 검색, 선생님 성함으로 찾기. Input: query text is matched partially, case-insensitively, against the employee's name or work area. Returns: id, name, grade, workArea, openToNextWork, and status (available/working/unavailable) when the search can compute it. Does not expose rest days, leave schedules or a detailed availability calendar. Requires a specific name or area; never pass a generic word such as 관리사, 직원 or 도우미 as the query — ask the user instead.

capabilities.name: employees.update
capabilities.description: Update an employee after explicit approval

capabilities.name: files.delete
capabilities.description: Delete an authorized file after strong approval

capabilities.name: files.metadata
capabilities.description: Read authorized file metadata without signed URLs

capabilities.name: files.search
capabilities.description: Search authorized files for the current branch

capabilities.name: messages.createTemplate
capabilities.description: Create a message template after explicit approval

capabilities.name: messages.deliveryHistory
capabilities.description: List SMS delivery lifecycle history for the current branch

capabilities.name: messages.previewSms
capabilities.description: Preview SMS content and cost category

capabilities.name: messages.retrySms
capabilities.description: Retry a provider-rejected SMS after strong approval

capabilities.name: messages.scheduleSms
capabilities.description: Schedule an SMS after strong approval

capabilities.name: messages.sendSms
capabilities.description: Send an SMS after strong approval

capabilities.name: messages.updateTemplate
capabilities.description: Update a message template after explicit approval

capabilities.name: notifications.test
capabilities.description: Persist a test notification and attempt web push after explicit approval

capabilities.name: policy.retrieve
capabilities.description: Retrieve versioned operational policy for explanatory answers

capabilities.name: schedules.list
capabilities.description: List employee work schedules (client assignments) for the current branch, optionally filtered to one calendar date. Use for: 오늘 일정, 이번주 스케줄, 방문 일정 확인, 특정 날짜 배정 확인. Input: optional date (YYYY-MM-DD); when given, only schedules overlapping that date are returned, up to 50 rows sorted by start date. Does not accept a client or employee name — cross-reference the returned ids with clients.get or employees.get. Returns: id, clientId, primaryEmployeeId, secondaryEmployeeId, startDate, endDate, replaced.

capabilities.name: service-records.oversight
capabilities.description: Read service-record case oversight rows (session-count and finalization/document tracking) for the current branch — operational status, not the submitted form content. Use for: 제공기록지 진행상황, 서비스 종료 처리 현황, 최종 승인 여부. Input: optional limit (max 50, default 20); any query text is ignored — this capability has no search field. Resolve a client's id via clients.search first, then match it against the returned clientId. Returns: id, clientId, status, startDate, endDate, requiredSessionCount, formVersion, plus finalization/completion timestamps and retry metadata.

capabilities.name: settings.read
capabilities.description: Read explicitly approved operational policies for the current branch

capabilities.name: vouchers.prices
capabilities.description: Read the branch's voucher price list (government voucher service pricing by type, duration and year) — not an individual client's voucher balance or usage. Use for: 바우처 단가, 정부지원 가격표, 서비스 요금 확인. Input: optional year (2000-2100) and optional type keyword, matched partially. Returns, up to 100 rows: id, type, duration, fullPrice, grant, actualPrice, year.

capabilities.name: website.settings
capabilities.description: Read the public ribbon configuration without exposing raw system settings

capabilities.name: website.updateSettings
capabilities.description: Update website settings after approval
